packageRules.description: The pg majors in pgrx-base-images.toml are the support matrix, not staleness: each key deliberately maps to its own major (building 14 against 18 is not an update, it is a different matrix). Only digest and suffix refreshes within each major flow; new majors enter by adding a key, a reviewed change.

customManagers.description: signer pin: security/signer.pin declares the commit every sign.yml uses: pins, so the release verifier checks against the same tree that signed — bump it in the same PR as the uses: lines or lint:signer-pin reddens the gate. The match is a bare digest and the file holds nothing else, deliberately: a regex manager replaces the WHOLE matched span, so the original marker-based match ('# renovate: signer-pin\n<digest>') destroyed its own marker on the first bump (#279 rewrote the 10-line file to one line), after which nothing matched and every later bump half-landed — uses: moved, the pin did not, and lint:signer-pin reddened each one. Matching the entire meaningful content makes replace-the-match the correct operation instead of a destructive one; lint:signer-pin asserts the file shape this depends on.
pgrx base images: keep tag AND digest current together in docker/pgrx-base-images.toml — a pinned-but-stale base is worse than a floating one
